statement_summary: Security lead and building system owners designated in writing
Annual risk assessment using SP 800-30
Risk acceptance authority by risk level
Vendor security addendum; annual review of remote management providers
Annual independent control assessment
Change control for BAS, access control, and vendor-enabled features
Life-safety systems stay separate; read-only relays only
Unique accounts; no shared logins, including OT and vendors
Least privilege; 2 named platform administrators; separate admin accounts
MFA for all sensitive and remote access; hardware keys for admins
Same-day account and badge removal at termination
Tenant roster attestation; auto-suspend badges unused for 60 days
Break-glass accounts sealed offline and tested quarterly
16-character passwords; change defaults at commissioning; OT passwords in the password manager
Integrator access through the gateway with MFA, approval, and recording
Runbooks with OT safety steps and manual operating procedures
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour
Documented breach determination; written no-harm determinations kept 5 years
Meet notice deadlines in the P08 matrix
Ransom only with owner, counsel, insurer approval and OFAC check
Annual tabletop with engineering and console staff
Central security logs kept 1 year; weekly review; OT alerts
Encrypt Restricted data at rest and in transit
Card data only in P2PE terminals; never on paper or email
Data inventory and quarterly OT asset inventory
Certified destruction; shred paper with personal information
Retention limits, including 30 days for visitor ID images
Isolated immutable backups, controller programs, quarterly restore tests
Annual awareness, phishing exercises, OT and card-handling role training
No unapproved software or devices on OT networks
USB control and contractor laptop scans; autorun disabled
Approved AI tools and analytics features only
